title: Item Refinement
text:
Place an item in the cultivation menu's refinement slot. Refinement continues after closing the menu.


Swords bind to you as flying swords.


Pills are analyzed without being consumed, revealing their name, effect and purity.


Jade slips are consumed to unlock a teaching in Help; already learned slips are preserved.


External cultivators can also refine spirit stones for cultivation progress and stored Qi. The Refining Spirit Stones teaching details the rewards and timing.
